attr.title: Super Chicken Jumper
attr.desc: A spy-chicken tries to save the world from doom in this runner/shooter game that has a little bit of everything with a touch of chicken and anime girls on top. Run for your life in 6 different worlds and shoot your way through tons of enemies until you become a legend.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and use following command in Steam console to obtain compatible files: download_depot 584640 584641 4197574832203956296. Copy downloaded files into assets folder.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/584640/SUPER_CHICKEN_JUMPER/) and use following command in [Steam console](steam://open/console) to obtain compatible files: `download_depot 584640 584641 4197574832203956296`. Copy downloaded files into `assets` folder.
